clips.title: The story
paras: Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill cares nothing for why the wizards of Dalaran raised a great dome of magic over their city's heart. What matters is that the ruined outskirts beyond the dome may conceal treasures of real magical worth, while the wizards and their elemental slaves patrol the area. Voidglare wants those patrols thinned.

After Prison Break In, Voidglare turns to the wizards of Dalaran, who raised a great dome of magic over their city's heart. Some say it shelters them from the violence of the age; others say they simply wanted solitude to study and plot. Voidglare does not care which. The ruined outskirts beyond the dome may conceal treasures of real magical worth, but the wizards and their elemental slaves patrol the area. You are to hunt six Dalaran Summoners and twelve Elemental Slaves, then return to Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The wizards of Dalaran constructed a vast, magical dome around the heart of their city. Some believe it was for protection from the violence of these times, while others say they merely wanted solitude, to study and plot.
I don't care what the reason was. I do care that the ruined outskirts of their city, outside the dome, may hide valuable magical treasures.
But the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.
So hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you yet thinned the Dalaran patrols around their ruins?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. Those ruins should now be safe enough to search, if one is careful.
